note: Draft god-card catalog. Orisha names and domains are the captions on Keith's 2026-10-14 portrait grid, in grid order. Greek cards caption the name only; those domains are conventional epithets (domain_source is conventional). Lore and stats are draft catalog text, not liturgy and not a ranking of the deities. Portrait crops are not in this repo: art.checksum stays null until a file is added. Missing art is a validator warning, not an error.

sources.layout: 4x4, row-major, cell 0 is top-left. Name captions only.

cards.name: OLORUN
cards.lore: Draft. OLORUN is named on this card as supreme creator, owner of the sky. The line is a short label for the Haven set, not a prayer and not a full teaching.
